title: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures just days after the big ground stop

contentText:
United Airlines passenger planes are seen at gates at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) in Newark, New Jersey, on November 15, 2026. | AFP via Getty Images

Less than a week after an issue with air traffic control communications and radar caused the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide , United Airlines departing flights are being disrupted by an outage. The airline has said it is working to get things up and running again as quickly as possible, but without much detail about the issue itself.

The outage is also coming after last week's global Microsoft Outlook shutdown , and the great-bank-outage-that-wasn't earlier Monday afternoon.
